d.why: Billy is on screen in Cloak & Dagger 1.01 and 1.08 (flashbacks) and in Tyrone's visions in 1.02 and 1.03, and he is Tyrone Johnson's brother.
Duane is on screen in Cloak & Dagger 1.01 and 1.08 (flashbacks), 1.03 (vision), 1.05 and 1.06.
Fuchs is on screen in Cloak & Dagger 1.02, 1.05, 1.06 and 1.08, and his body is found in 1.09.
Greg is on screen in Cloak & Dagger 1.02, 1.03 and 1.04.
Ivan is on screen in Cloak & Dagger 1.05 (vision) and 1.06 to 1.09, and in flashbacks in 1.07.
Mikayla is on screen in Cloak & Dagger 2.01, 2.02, 2.09 and 2.10.
Nathan is on screen in Cloak & Dagger flashbacks in 1.01, 1.07 and 1.08, a vision in 1.03, and visions or illusions in 2.02 and 2.04, and he is Tandy Bowen's father.
Rick is on screen in Cloak & Dagger 1.01 and 1.03.
Roland is on screen in Cloak & Dagger 1.04 (Call/Response), 1.08 (Ghost Stories) and 1.10 (Colony Collapse).
Bronaja is on screen in Inhumans 1.01, 1.02, 1.03, 1.06 and 1.07.
Flora is on screen in Inhumans 1.03 to 1.08 as one of Auran's guards on Oahu.

Pena appears only in Inhumans 1.03, a police captain who stonewalls Louise and the press and puts Black Bolt in general population, which is an obstacle in Black Bolt's story, not its villain; he is no one's family, spouse or boss among filed people.
Destiny is on screen in Runaways 1.01 and 1.02, in an illusion in 1.03, and among the sacrificed teens in the thin place in season 3.
Eiffel is on screen in Runaways 1.01, 1.05, 1.07, 1.09, 2.04 and 2.05.
Flores is on screen in Runaways 1.04 and 2.01, 2.03, 2.07, 2.08 and 2.09.
Kincaid is on screen in Runaways Fifteen (1.04) and Metamorphosis (1.06), and in a flashback in Tsunami (1.08).
Mike is on screen in Runaways 2.01, 2.04 and 2.13.
Tamar is on screen in many Runaways episodes from 1.09 through season 3, and she is Darius Davis's widow.
Von Rantenraven appears only in Spider-Man (1967) season 3 episode 3A, where he is the villain of the episode, attacking New York from Sky Harbor until Spider-Man brings it down.
Uncle Ben appears only in Spider-Man (1967) season 2 episode 1, the origin, where the plot turns on his murder by the burglar Peter let go; he is also Peter Parker's uncle and May's husband.
The wax Blackbeard appears only in Spider-Man (1967) episode 11A, one of three wax figures Parafino sends out; it steals a treasure chest at the start, while Parafino is the episode's villain.
Blackwell is on screen in two Spider-Man (1967) episodes: 17B, where he helps Spider-Man beat the Green Goblin, and 13B, where he saves the Old Castle Theatre.
Boomer appears only in Spider-Man (1967) season 2 episode 16 (season 3 episode 13 reuses old footage); he is the episode's villain, a bank robber who frees Vulcan to help him steal gold.
Brutus appears only in Spider-Man (1967) episode 19B as Charles Cameo's bodyguard, who knocks Spider-Man down; Cameo is the villain the episode is about.
Carol appears only in Spider-Man (1967) season 2 episode 14, and the episode is about her: the alien girl Peter dates, who steals equipment to save her people.
Clive appears only in Spider-Man (1967) season 2 episode 15, where he is the villain, using his Spirit-Scope to bring the monster Blotto to life and take over the city.
Cowboy appears only in Spider-Man (1967) episode 14B as one of the two thugs the Plotter hires to steal blueprints; the Plotter is the villain behind the plot.
